notes.title: Dev_Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We've been a bit quiet the past few months, but that's 'cause we've been [i]cooking[/i]! Let's catch you up to speed.
[h2]What's changed? [/h2]
This (Bl)Oc(k)tober will be the 2 year anniversary of the GameJam in which [b]Block_Up[/b] was born. A lot of things have changed since then. Look at that glowup!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/cb7ad50abb8c86e5ff8232314309229b895bce13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/e152f2449a01ca772e06af0a49a882a86e755249.png[/img]

Apart from the visual update, we've also added a bunch more block types for you to break and place as you please, controller support for most things, tons of small QoL changes, as well as a fancy level editor! We look forward to seeing all the blocktastic levels you come up with. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/b24e1630beac4b9725893b4b1fa9a2114aff8dd6.png[/img]

[h2]Why's the blocking game not released yet?! [/h2]
Whilst the core game itself is basically done, a lot of the stuff [i]around[/i] the game isn't yet - the biggest and most important being [i]online multiplayer[/i]. But trust us when we say the game will be out as soon as it's ready - we want you to be able to play it too!

[h2]You mentioned [i]Blocktober[/i]? [/h2]
Oh yeah! To celebrate, we'll be holding a small event on our [i][url=https://discord.gg/7fBsNdjbuQ]Discord[/url][/i] in October. Don't forget to join it to stay updated - be there and be square! There may even be free keys to be won...

Until then, we'll return to our blocky game-making cave. Until next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/234679a7d2342777d396c347f80fd95f298a568b.png[/img]
